design_goals: account for all planned DOF/mechanical toys before freezing cabinet CNC geometry
provide dedicated power and signal routing corridors rather than ad-hoc wiring
preserve safe backbox folding without cable pinch or connector strain
make harness installation repeatable for CNC-flatpack builders
keep cooling independent of the PC operating system

rules: inside enclosed mains compartment where terminals are exposed
protective earth bonded to all exposed conductive chassis/metalwork as required
cross lower-voltage harnesses at approximately 90 degrees only when unavoidable

intended_loads: shaker motor where selected for 12 V
gear motor where selected for 12 V
wind/blower effect where selected for 12 V
beacon/siren/strobe modules when their selected hardware is 12 V
aux_12v.source_policy: dedicated fused auxiliary DC supply/bus preferred over motherboard fan headers or PC PSU peripheral leads for permanent cabinet loads

intended_loads: contactors/solenoids if 24 V hardware is selected
chimes/bells if selected hardware requires 24 V

backbox_ventilation.preferred_fans: 2 x 120 mm 12 V 4-pin PWM low-noise PC fans
backbox_ventilation.power_source: dedicated fused AUX 12 V cabinet bus

control.full_pinball_behavior: enabled whenever FULL PINBALL power domain is active; thermostat controls speed
control.audio_only_behavior: normally off unless backbox audio electronics dissipating significant heat are later located there
control.failsafe: loss of temperature-control signal should default to fan-on/full-safe behavior where supported

airflow.intake_location: lower backbox rear/bottom region plus cabinet-to-backbox passage

cable_routing_classes.B: high-current ELV / inductive DOF power and returns
cable_routing_classes.D: analog/low-level audio and amplifier signal wiring
cable_routing_classes.E: display video cables and display AC/DC power service loops

left_wall_low_voltage_raceway.runs: front service controls to rear electronics bay
left_wall_low_voltage_raceway.supports: CNC-located P-clips or removable slotted cable-raceway brackets at <=250 mm spacing

right_wall_power_raceway.runs: DC distribution to flipper/slings/bumper toys and rear/toy bay
right_wall_power_raceway.supports: CNC-located P-clips or removable raceway brackets at <=250 mm spacing

central_display_service_route.runs: playfield display HDMI/DP and power service loop
central_display_service_route.rule: kept clear of gas struts, safety prop and hinge motion

mains_route.runs: rear mains enclosure to protected internal distribution only
mains_route.rule: separate enclosed/routed path away from signal/audio

primary_fold_harness_passage.location: backbox floor / cabinet rear shelf near centerline, positioned outside hinge pinch zones

secondary_reserved_passage.purpose: future topper/toy/high-current harness or replacement-standard expansion

toy_harness_policy.all_inductive_toys: fused branch plus appropriate flyback/suppression at or near load/driver according to final controller design
toy_harness_policy.high_current_toys: dedicated branch conductors sized to measured load and protected at source
toy_harness_policy.quick_disconnects: locking polarized connectors with documented current rating; family selected at BOM stage
toy_harness_policy.service_disconnect_between_main_cabinet_: one or more keyed multipin connectors accessible with backbox upright, while normal folding remains possible without unplugging

preferred_supports: edge grommets on every wood/metal passage
avoid: adhesive-only cable tie bases for primary support
sharp plywood edges contacting wire insulation
zip ties directly on hinge pivots or gas-strut hardware
